Notes_and_Tips: Avoid soy and soy-based foods completely due to your allergy.
Take your thyroid medication on an empty stomach with plain water and wait at least 30–60 minutes before your first meal, if prescribed by your doctor.
Avoid skipping meals, especially during busy shift days or late nights.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Practice yoga regularly and include a 30-minute walk on most days to support thyroid health, PCOS management and healthy weight loss.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and choose pan fried or boiled foods instead of fried foods.
